mathcounts-potw-2026-01-05-01.prompt: Peitlyn decided that she would like to read more in 2026, so she made a resolution to read 30 minutes each day, starting January 1. If Peitlyn reads an average of 1 page every 2 minutes and she finishes her 6th book at the end of her reading session on March 31, 2026, what is the average number of pages per book for these six books?

mathcounts-potw-2026-01-05-02.prompt: Nora's resolution is to get more exercise. She decided that starting with the first full week in 2026, she will do a 45-minute workout four times each week (four days during every seven-day period). This means she will have to exercise four of the days during the week of Jan. 1 through Jan. 7, and then four of the days during the week of Jan. 8 through Jan. 14, etc. If Nora sticks to her resolution, what is the first possible date on which she could reach a total of 25 hours of exercise for the year?

mathcounts-potw-2026-01-05-03.prompt: Riley decided to cut back on the time that she spends watching television. During the first week of 2026 she will allow herself to watch her usual 22 hours of television. However, during each successive week of 2026, she will only allow herself to watch 90% of the time that she watched during the previous week. During which week (first, second, third, etc.) will her viewing time first be under 5 hours?
